responsibility: Coordinates construction of Itanium-ABI-based CFI type identifiers for function ABIs and instances by selecting encoding options from ABI properties, transforming instance and type shapes for cross-language compatibility, invoking the encoder, and appending option-dependent suffixes to the final metadata string.
same_name_distinction: Among the `mod.rs` files, this is the concrete Itanium C++ ABI backend implementation for CFI type ids. It contains the actual string construction logic, including ABI-sensitive encoding, type transformation, substitution compression, and suffix emission, whereas the sibling `typeid/mod.rs` files mainly expose APIs/options and the KCFI modules wrap or postprocess this result.
